officialLinks.label: Grade values and General Honors GPA
Yale School of Public Health grading

helpIntro: Yale College uses a 4.00 GPA scale with A=4.00 and no A+. Enter Yale course credits and final grades to estimate current, cumulative, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: For Yale College undergraduate planning. CR, P, and W are excluded from GPA; F counts as 0.00. Both grades count after a repeated course. Fractional 0.5/1.5-credit courses require manual review until the shared calculator supports fractional credit entry.
helpExample: A 1-credit A earns 4.00 grade points and a 1-credit B+ earns 3.33. Together, 7.33 ÷ 2 = 3.665.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.67 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.33 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.67 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.33 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.67 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.33 points per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 point per Yale course credit.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.67 points per Yale course credit; D- is passing.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.00 points and counts in the Yale GPA when it is a GPA-bearing course.
gradeExplanations.CR: Credit from Yale College Credit/D/Fail is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass in a Pass/Fail course is excluded from the Yale College GPA.
gradeExplanations.W: Withdrawal is neutral, carries no course credit, and is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.TI: Authorized Temporary Incomplete; use the final grade after it is resolved.
gradeExplanations.ABX: Authorized Absence from Final Examination; use the final grade after it is resolved.
gradeExplanations.NM: No Mark is not included in the qualitative GPA calculation; consult your dean/registrar about resolution.
gradeExplanations.SAT: Interim satisfactory mark in certain credit/year sequences; do not treat as a numerical GPA grade.
gradeExplanations.NSAT: Interim not-satisfactory mark in certain credit/year sequences; do not assign a numerical GPA value.

specialTypes.name: Yale College course (whole credit)
specialTypes.note: Use for standard Yale College courses carrying whole-number course credits.

specialTypes.name: Yale course with 0.5 or 1.5 credit
specialTypes.note: Current shared calculator cannot enter fractional course credits safely. Calculate manually or wait for fractional-credit UI support.

specialTypes.name: Transfer / outside university credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted outside credit can count toward degree requirements, but outside grades are not part of the Yale College GPA used for General Honors.

specialTypes.name: Professional-school course with nonletter grading
specialTypes.note: Professional-school grading can use Pass/Fail, SAT/NSAT, Credit/Fail, or other systems. Confirm the Yale College transcript treatment before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed row. Do not use a grade-replacement estimate for the Yale College GPA.
